channel.title: Video Pulse Review
channel.description: Independent viewing guides for restoration, factory process, and practical engineering videos.

item.title: My First Mistake as an Engineer | Engineering Breakdown
item.description: This viewing guide accompanies "My First Mistake as an Engineer" by Practical Engineering. It frames the video around the problem being solved, the mechanism or build choice involved, and the evidence that shows whether the idea works outside the initial demonstration.

item.title: Paper Notebook Production | From Wood Logs to Finished Notebooks –... | Factory Process Guide

Look for the change from raw material to formed parts, the role of repeatable machinery, and the checks used before a finished product leaves the line.
